purpose: Six reusable head-only expressions, with transparent backgrounds, mapped to all 41 UI states.

prompts.label: Hello / welcome
prompts.expression: EXPRESSION: welcoming open-eye smile. Keep both small cocoa faceted bead eyes and the gentle U-shaped smile from the original. Warm, approachable, attentive. This is the neutral friendly head asset.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Create a HEAD-ONLY expression asset of the EXACT Apollo character in the attached reference. This is an expression edit and a crop to the head, not a redesign. Preserve the original faceted low-polygon 3D geometry, polished matte resin rendering, coral-red apple hood, cream inset face, small protruding coral button nose, faceted blush cheek discs, cocoa facial details, cinnamon-brown polygonal stem tilted left, and single muted sage-green faceted leaf pointing upper right. Preserve the reference's camera angle, head proportions, subtle tilt, top-left studio lighting and tonal colors.
Show only his complete rounded apple hood HEAD with face, stem and leaf. Remove the entire body, neck, arms and hands. The bottom silhouette should be the naturally rounded apple hood, not a flat chopped-off neck. Entire stem and leaf visible. Large centered head, consistent 80% canvas fill, square canvas, generous clear margin. Genuinely transparent background with clean alpha: NO ground plane, NO shadow outside the head, NO colored glow, NO vignette, NO checkerboard rendered into pixels, NO text, no symbols floating around him, no border.
Keep large visible polygon facets. NOT fuzzy, NOT plush, NOT smooth spherical plastic, NOT clipart, NOT 2D. Face features are sculpted dark-brown shapes attached to the cream face. Every aspect except the specified facial expression must match the source.
EXPRESSION: welcoming open-eye smile. Keep both small cocoa faceted bead eyes and the gentle U-shaped smile from the original. Warm, approachable, attentive. This is the neutral friendly head asset.

prompts.label: Happy / completed
prompts.expression: EXPRESSION: very happy ^_^ face for finishing a check-in. Replace BOTH dot eyes with cute CLOSED HAPPY EYES shaped like gently rounded upward peaks / arches, like ^ ^ or inverted U curves. The eyes must visibly read as smiling eyes, NOT open dots. Give him a slightly broader sweet U-shaped happy smile, small and friendly, mouth closed, NO teeth. Keep round coral button nose and round blush cheeks exactly like reference. Quiet delight and pride, adorable.

A tiny relaxed content smile. Keep button nose and blush. Calm attentive presence; not sick, sad or asleep.

Both little cocoa bead eyes open, gaze slightly upward, one very small gently raised eyebrow above one eye, and a tiny rounded o-shaped mouth as if saying 'oh!'. Keep the cute coral button nose and original round blush cheeks. Subtle cute curiosity, NOT shock or worry. Do not change the head position or shape.

Keep the cute coral button nose and round blush cheeks. Reads as 'we can try again' with warmth; not smug, laughing or sarcastic.
